item.title: Burch Dental Spa, Machesney Park, IL
item.content:encoded:
Type

Dental Practice

Location

Machesney Park, IL

Square Footage

7000 SF

Project Timeline

28 weeks

Main project goals

Craft a cutting-edge, streamlined environment for the new Burch Dental location in Machesney Park

  • Create a modern, efficient space for Burch Dental Machesney Park location
  • Enhance the patient experience through custom design elements and attention to detail in order to achieve combination of stylish modern and welcoming ambiance
  • Optimize the floor plan for improved workflow and productivity, patient’s and team member’s comfort
  • Updating over-all building appearance transforming form outdated bricks to modern composite facade
  • Improvement of natural light exposure by adding additional windows for treatment rooms

Scope of work

  • Layout design and in space virtual walk-through presentation
  • Interior design
  • Architectural drawings and permit application
  • Exterior build out, existing windows replacement and additional windows installation
  • Interior design and complete interior build-out
  • Central Nitrous Installation
  • Custom dental cabinetry design, fabrication, and installation
  • Custom reception desk design, fabrication, and installation
  • Custom office cabinetry and furniture design, fabrication, and installation
  • IT network and sound system wiring and installation
item.excerpt:encoded: Transforming existing dental practice in to the new modern home of Mc Govan’s Family Dental.
